quiz.question_id: Mengapa lesson menekankan `path/filepath` dan bukan `path` untuk filesystem lokal?
quiz.question_en: Why does the lesson emphasize `path/filepath` instead of `path` for local filesystems?
options_id: Karena `filepath` menangani separator path sesuai OS secara otomatis
Karena `path` tidak bisa dipakai dengan string
options_en: Because `filepath` automatically handles path separators for the current OS
Because `path` has been removed from Go
Because `filepath` only works on Windows
Because `path` cannot be used with strings

quiz.question_en: If `p := filepath.Join("home", "user", "documents", "file.txt")`, what is the main benefit of `Join`?
options_id: Menyusun path dengan separator yang benar secara cross-platform
options_en: It assembles a path with the correct separator in a cross-platform way
It turns the file into an absolute path
It creates the directory on disk
It validates file permissions

quiz.question_en: For the path `home/user/documents/file.txt`, what does `filepath.Base(p)` return?
options_en: `home/user/documents`
`file.txt`
`.txt`
`file`

quiz.question_id: Pada path yang sama, hasil `filepath.Ext(p)` adalah?
quiz.question_en: For that same path, what does `filepath.Ext(p)` return?
options_en: `file`
`documents`
`.txt`
`file.txt`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa contoh menghitung nama tanpa ekstensi dengan `base[:len(base)-len(ext)]`?
quiz.question_en: Why does the example compute the name without extension using `base[:len(base)-len(ext)]`?
options_id: Untuk menghapus suffix ekstensi dari nama file dasar
Untuk mengubah relative path menjadi absolute path
Untuk membaca isi file tanpa ekstensi
Untuk memeriksa apakah file adalah direktori
options_en: To remove the extension suffix from the base filename
To turn a relative path into an absolute path
To read the file contents without its extension
To check whether the file is a directory

quiz.question_id: Apa perbedaan penting antara `os.Mkdir` dan `os.MkdirAll` menurut lesson?
quiz.question_en: What is the important difference between `os.Mkdir` and `os.MkdirAll` according to the lesson?
options_id: `MkdirAll` dapat membuat parent directory yang belum ada juga
`MkdirAll` selalu membuat file kosong di tiap level
options_en: `MkdirAll` can also create any missing parent directories
`Mkdir` can only be used for files
`MkdirAll` always creates an empty file at each level
There is no behavioral difference

quiz.question_en: When is `os.ReadDir` a better fit than `filepath.WalkDir`?
options_id: Saat hanya ingin membaca isi satu direktori tanpa traversal rekursif
Saat ingin menjelajahi semua subdirektori secara rekursif
Saat ingin mengubah separator path otomatis
options_en: When you only want the contents of one directory without recursive traversal
When you want to walk all subdirectories recursively
When you want to automatically change path separators
When you want to delete a directory

quiz.question_id: Dalam callback `filepath.WalkDir`, mengapa contoh memeriksa `!d.IsDir() && filepath.Ext(path) == ".go"`?
quiz.question_en: Inside the `filepath.WalkDir` callback, why does the example check `!d.IsDir() && filepath.Ext(path) == ".go"`?
options_id: Untuk memproses hanya file Go dan mengabaikan direktori
Untuk membuat semua direktori menjadi package Go
Untuk memastikan semua file punya ekstensi
options_en: To process only Go files and ignore directories
To delete all non-Go files
To turn all directories into Go packages
To ensure every file has an extension

quiz.question_id: Apa konsekuensi dari `return err` di dalam callback `WalkDir` ketika parameter `err` tidak nil?
quiz.question_en: What is the consequence of `return err` inside the `WalkDir` callback when the `err` parameter is not nil?
options_id: Traversal melaporkan error itu ke pemanggil alih-alih mengabaikannya diam-diam
Traversal otomatis melanjutkan ke item berikutnya tanpa error
Semua path berikutnya di-skip tetapi fungsi mengembalikan nil
options_en: The traversal reports that error back to the caller instead of silently ignoring it
The traversal automatically continues to the next item without error
The error is converted into a warning string
All later paths are skipped but the function still returns nil

quiz.question_id: Manakah pasangan operasi dan fungsi yang benar menurut bagian akhir lesson?
quiz.question_en: Which operation and function pairing is correct according to the final section of the lesson?
options_en: Delete a directory recursively with `os.RemoveAll`
Rename a file with `filepath.WalkDir`
Read file info with `os.Environ`
Create nested directories with `filepath.Base`
